title: api: websocket + lifespan listener, cli api/new-world/pause/resume
criteria:
1) realm/api/ws.py: pure helpers `psycopg_dsn(url: str) -> str` (strip '+psycopg' from the SQLAlchemy URL: 'postgresql+psycopg://u:p@h:5432/d' -> 'postgresql://u:p@h:5432/d') and `message_for(payload: str, human_ids: set[int]) -> dict | None` (parse the pg_notify JSON {world_id, player_ids, kind, village_id}; return {'type': 'changed', 'kind': kind, 'village_id': village_id} only when at least one of player_ids is in human_ids, else None; invalid JSON -> None); class `Hub` with a set of connected WebSockets, `async connect(ws)` (accept + add), `disconnect(ws)`, `async broadcast(message: dict)` (send_json to every socket, silently dropping sockets that fail); a module-level `hub = Hub()`; `router = APIRouter()` with `@router.websocket('/ws')`: connect, loop on `await ws.receive_text()`, reply the text 'pong' when the received text is 'ping', remove from hub on WebSocketDisconnect; `async def listen_loop() -> None`: forever (until cancelled): connect `psycopg.AsyncConnection.connect(psycopg_dsn(settings.database_url), autocommit=True)`, `await conn.execute('LISTEN game_events')`, `async for n in conn.notifies():` look up the human player ids of the notification's world (sync DB query run through `asyncio.to_thread`, using realm.db.session.session_scope and models Player where is_bot False, cached in a dict by world_id) then `await hub.broadcast(msg)` when message_for(...) is not None; on any exception except asyncio.CancelledError: log with logging.getLogger('realm.api'), sleep 2 s, reconnect.
2) realm/api/main.py: add a FastAPI `lifespan` async context manager that starts `asyncio.create_task(ws.listen_loop())` on startup and cancels it (and awaits it, ignoring CancelledError) on shutdown; pass lifespan= to FastAPI(...); include ws.router (no prefix) BEFORE mounting the static files. Everything else in main.py stays as is.
3) realm/cli.py: implement `api` (uvicorn.run('realm.api.main:create_app', factory=True, host=settings.api_host, port=settings.api_port)), `new-world` (options --speed int default 1, --name str default 'ผู้เล่น', --tribe str default 'stonehold', --bots int default 30, --seed int optional (random if missing); creates the world with worlds.create_world(s, seed=..., speed=..., player_name=name, tribe=tribe, bot_count=bots, cfg=load_config(), real_now=datetime.now(timezone.utc)) inside `with session_scope() as s:` and echoes one line with world id, speed and seed), `pause` and `resume` (worlds.pause/resume inside session_scope with real_now=datetime.now(timezone.utc), echo 'paused'/'resumed'). Import `session_scope` at MODULE level in cli.py (`from realm.db.session import session_scope`) so tests can monkeypatch `realm.cli.session_scope`; keep other imports lazy where they are heavy (uvicorn inside api()). `migrate` and `engine` and `bots` and `simulate` remain exactly as they are.
Tests tests/api/test_ws_cli.py: psycopg_dsn cases; message_for cases (human included -> dict, only bots -> None, bad JSON -> None, village_id None passes through); websocket ping->pong using TestClient(create_app(serve_static=False)) WITHOUT entering it as a context manager (no lifespan); Hub.broadcast sends to two fake sockets (small async fake class with send_json) and drops a socket whose send_json raises (use asyncio.run); lifespan starts and cancels the listener: monkeypatch `realm.api.ws.listen_loop` (and make sure main.py looks it up as `ws.listen_loop` at startup time, not at import time) with a coroutine that sets a flag then sleeps forever, enter `with TestClient(app):`, assert flag set, and after exit the task was cancelled (flag2 set in a `finally`); CLI with typer.testing.CliRunner and monkeypatch.setattr('realm.cli.session_scope', fake) where fake is a contextmanager yielding the `s` fixture session: `new-world --speed 3 --name ทดสอบ --tribe ironwild --bots 0 --seed 5` exit code 0 and a World row with speed 3, seed 5 exists with player 'ทดสอบ'; then `pause` -> world.paused_at is not None; `resume` -> paused_at None; `realm --help` still lists all 8 commands.
notes:
- For the ping/pong test use `with client.websocket_connect('/ws') as sock: sock.send_text('ping'); assert sock.receive_text() == 'pong'`.
- main.py: lifespan = asynccontextmanager; look up `ws.listen_loop` via the module (`from realm.api import ws` then `ws.listen_loop()`).
- psycopg is already installed (psycopg[binary]); use `import psycopg` and `psycopg.AsyncConnection.connect(...)`; `conn.notifies()` yields objects with `.payload` (str).
- Fake sockets for Hub tests: class FakeWS: async def send_json(self, data): self.sent.append(data); and a BadWS whose send_json raises RuntimeError. Hub.broadcast must iterate over a copy of the set.
- Short correct Thai only (the --name default 'ผู้เล่น'); check tone marks.
